changelog:
### VietLab v1.0.4 - Doi hinh nen phong may, Cai dat phan mem tu dong qua LAN & Toi uu Dieu khien tu xa

- Doi hinh nen phong may dong loat: Dat hinh nen chuan VietLab hoac hinh anh tuy chinh xuong toan bo may con hoac may da chon ngay tuc thi ma khong can khoi dong lai.
- Trung tam cai dat phan mem tu dong (Silent Deploy): Cai dat ngam 1-Click cac ung dung pho bien (Chrome, UniKey, UltraViewer, Notepad++, Scratch, Python...) qua mang LAN noi bo sieu toc.
- Bao tri & Quet Windows Update: Kich hoat quet va cap nhat ban va Windows tu xa phuc vu bao tri phong may.
- Sua triet de dieu khien tu xa (Remote Control): Tinh toan chinh xac toa do chuot pixel-perfect 1:1, go phim truc tiep xuong may hoc sinh, bam an ngay 100%.
- Loai bo loi lap ket noi va Toast spam: Khac phuc vong lap tu dong nang cap ngam cua Client cu va bo sung cooldown thong bao tren Server.
